Why can I not open a document yet?

Files stay blocked while checks are pending or when they are quarantined. A file signature check does not establish that a PDF is safe. Follow the status shown in the wallet; upload and preview safeguards still apply.
Does a readiness percentage predict visa approval?
No. It counts satisfied requirements for the attached rules. Unknown applicability, missing evidence and your confirmation remain separate. The destination authority decides your application.
When does sharing start, and how can I end it?

A recipient must accept the exact grant before access starts. Review the scope and expiry before confirming. Pause stops future access until resumed; revoke ends it. Neither can recall copies already downloaded.
I did not receive a confirmation or password-reset email.
Check spam and the address you entered. Use the confirmation page to resend a verification link, or request another password-reset link. Delivery to a mail server does not guarantee inbox placement.
